title: Add contrastive anchor signer and explainable flakiness report for prompt regressions
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: We need finer-grained, explainable signal for prompt-set regressions that ties a failing prompt cohort back to concrete anchor examples and minimal contrastive perturbations. Motivation: existing regression gates flag failures but don't provide actionable provenance for triage or automated soft-fix suggestions. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) a Contrastive Anchor Signer that selects and cryptographically signs canonical anchor examples per prompt cohort and stores provenance metadata; (2) an Explainable Flakiness Reporter that produces a human- and machine-readable breakdown for CI and post-merge triage (token-level delta heatmap, contrastive exemplar pairs, likely regression causes and suggested fixes). Changeset summary: - Adds anchor selection and signing pipeline (anchor_signer.py + integration hooks) - Adds flakiness_reporter with CLI and CI adapter to attach artifacts to PRs - Introduces a light-weight contrastive perturbation sampler for generating minimal edits to surface sensitivity - Adds unit and integration tests for selection, signing, and report generation - Adds CI job that runs the report on pre-merge smoke evals and uploads artifacts Checklist: - [x] Anchor signer algorithm implemented and covered by unit tests - [x] Reporter emits JSON + HTML artifacts and short summary to CI logs - [x] CI job wired into eval-smoke workflow (soft-fail by default) - [x] Docs: design doc link and usage examples included - [x] Backwards compatibility: anchor metadata stored in new lineage bucket, old consumers ignore if absent Implementation notes: - Anchor signer uses a contrastive scoring function (cohort similarity + representativeness penalty) to pick 3 anchors per prompt-set, then signs the anchor id + canonicalization hash with a repo-managed key to prevent accidental anchor churn. Signing is intentionally simple (HMAC-SHA256) and documented in docs/anchor_signing.md. - Flakiness reporter consumes eval traces and produces: 1) per-prompt delta summary (accuracy/metric drop), 2) token-level saliency heatmap between baseline and candidate, 3) contrastive exemplar pairs showing minimal edit that flips behaviour, 4) suggested quick-actions (fix prompt, widen tolerance, pin model). - CI integration: new job eval:flakiness-report runs on PRs touching prompt files or eval logic, attaches artifacts to the PR, and returns a soft-fail signal when the regression severity is low/medium; high severity returns fail. Rollout plan: soft-launch behind a feature flag (FF.contrastive_anchor_report) and gate only on selected repos (platform-internal teams) for 2 weeks before enabling org-wide. Related work: linear/ENG-5219 anchors design doc (link: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-5219/contrastive-anchors), previous anchor work in eval-harness: see pr-314159 and pr-430111. Risks & mitigations: - Risk: anchor churn causing noisy signals. Mitigation: signing + cool-down (anchors cannot be rotated more than once per 7 days without explicit override). - Risk: CI time increase. Mitigation: reporter runs sampled smoke and uses cached KV traces when available. Documentation: docs/anchor_signing.md, docs/flakiness_reporter.md A note on data storage: anchor artifacts go to s3://redwood-eval/anchors/{cohort}/{anchor_id}. Signed manifest format is documented and intentionally minimal to make downstream consumption easy.

review_thread: Diego Martinez (reviewer): Nice approach overall. Two main asks: 1) can we make the signer key rotation explicit in the config and 2) prefer using our internal crypto helper rather than raw hmac?
Maya Chen (author): Reply: answered — switched to internal crypto helper and added key_rotation_period_days config (default 7). Updated docs with rotation guidance.
Priya Rao (reviewer): The HTML artifact is heavy; can we add a minimal JSON-first output so automation can consume without parsing HTML?
Maya Chen (author): Added --json-only flag and default reporter emits both JSON and a lightweight HTML summary. Tests updated accordingly.
Liam O'Connor (reviewer): CI job adds ~30s on average; can we gate it to only run when prompt files or eval code changes?
Maya Chen (author): CI change updated to conditionally run (paths filter) and to use cached traces when available; measured median add time is now ~8s on our smoke runner.
Priya Rao (reviewer): Approved after the json-only output addition and key rotation config.
Diego Martinez (reviewer): Approved after swap to internal crypto helper.
Repo Admin (merge): Squash-merged via web UI.
release_notes: Add contrastive anchor signer to create signed canonical anchor examples for prompt cohorts.
Introduce explainable flakiness reporter that emits JSON and HTML artifacts for CI and triage, including token-level saliency and contrastive exemplar pairs.
New CI job eval:flakiness-report (soft-fail by default) and docs for configuration and key rotation.
